title: A kb_feedback report repeated after its first row was delivered records no second row or own entry
goal: A repeated kb_feedback report (same pack handle and closed fields) after its first row was delivered records no second row or own entry: the repeat check (ql_capture, today it reads only rows still in the spool) reads a bounded record that outlives delivery, or distill drops a report its stored entry already holds; a test delivers one report and repeats it.
